description.en: A soft lens that follows your cursor and redraws the live HTML beneath it as ascii characters.
description.zh: 透镜随指针移动，将下方的网页内容重绘为 ASCII 字符。

discovery.caveat: 涉及实时 HTML 捕获，先查看详情中的浏览器要求与回退说明。 从 Canvas UI 原站选择框架和渲染器，按原站说明安装。

notice.en: Use the Canvas UI documentation to choose a framework and install from its original registry.
notice.zh: 从 Canvas UI 原站选择框架和渲染器，按原站说明安装。
